case.summary: Customer C08299 reported an unauthorized online purchase of $30.02 (transaction 3581141) on card C08299-K1. The flagged transaction produced an elevated fraud model score of 0.984, corresponding to a 92.1% historical fraud rate. The cardholder baseline contains zero prior transactions and no recurring billing history, offering no positive evidence of legitimate customer authorization. Although graph analysis identified no device ring links or community lift, the corroborated model score and absence of legitimate holder activity confirm card-not-present fraud. Card C08299-K1 was blocked to prevent further loss.
